## Overview

**Ashura Zando** is a member of the **Zandorion family**, a middle-upper class Shadar-kai noble house in the Shadowfell shadow-city. He is the father of **Vaelis Zandorian (Zan)** and, together with his wife Athena Orion, made the impossible choice to abandon their son to save his life.

---

## Background

When Zan was seven years old, the Raven Queen's brand manifested on his skin -- the mark of direct bloodline descent, signifying that the Queen had chosen him. He was the youngest ever to receive this honor.

But the brand brought danger. Higher families -- envious of the Zandorions' rise and covetous of the Queen's favor -- began to scheme. Assassins were hired. Plots were woven. The Zandorion family could not protect their son from the political machinations of the Shadowfell nobility.

In desperation, Ashura and his wife Athena made an impossible choice: they would secretly abandon Zan on the Material Plane, modify his memory so he would not remember why, and replace him with an orphan named Dun'vis who physically resembled him. A tattooed replica of the brand would complete the deception. The hunters would chase the decoy, and the true heir would be safe.

Ashura and Athena carry the weight of this decision every day. They live with guilt, pain, anger, and the quiet hope of seeing Zan again. He is a kind but tough man, and sometimes his pain surfaces as misguided anger toward Dun'vis -- the living reminder of what they sacrificed.

---

## Goals

1. Keep the Zandorion family safe
2. Protect the secret of Zan's abandonment
3. Ensure Dun'vis can survive in Zan's place
4. One day see Zan again -- and hope he is alive and well

---

3. [hourglass] **What would happen if father and son met again?**
